resolvedFindings.fix: Concrete rider/mount indices remain reserved across nested callbacks; nested public requests and direct SpawnMonster exclude outer reservations. The scope releases remaining reservations in an injected outer finally.
MountIndex(-1) selects a separate free reserved slot after rider selection; -1 remains the automatic sentinel.

A private boolean is appended to CreateAgent and CreateHorseAgentFromRosterElements; all in-assembly callers are rewritten. Only SpawnAgent routes true, horse forwards it, and arm is immediately before CreateAgentInternal after all preparation calls. No native lookup callback assumptions.
Equal normalized output and receipt paths rejected before writing.

Preexisting branch/switch/EH entry into insertion call sites is rejected; all short branches in changed methods are expanded; complete normalized IL, branch/switch targets, EH regions and locals round-trip exactly; all other method bodies also compare exactly.

callContracts.SpawnAgent: Entry admission runs before original water renderer wait and rider allocation. Rider creates before mount; scoped concrete reservations protect remaining mount slot during OnAgentCreated callbacks. Finally releases reservations on all body returns and exceptions.
callContracts.SpawnMonster: ItemRoster overload forwards to EquipmentElement overload, which calls private horse helper with reservation flag false; guarded CreateAgentInternal rejects full/invalid/occupied indices before native invocation. Stock random mount-key selection occurs before this guard and can consume RNG on rejection.
callContracts.CreateAgentInternal: Guard returns a validated explicit index; STARG.2 supplies it to existing IMBMission.CreateAgent. The already-existing native explicit-index path performs Agent reset and same four active-pool bookkeeping; no new native instructions are introduced.
callContracts.PublicSignatures: Only two private method signatures gain a boolean. Both public SpawnMonster signatures, SpawnAgent and CreateAgentInternal retain existing signatures.

tests.name: independent IL stack-depth/control-flow and cleanup checks

limitations: No in-game execution of the managed admission patch in this review; parent must independently review and package exact providers before an authorized runtime test.
Direct native entrypoints remain unsafe on overflow and outside the supported public managed API.
No rollback is promised for unrelated stock initialization errors after an Agent is successfully allocated; the fix prevents capacity exhaustion from stealing a reserved mount slot.
Thread confinement and valid coherent pool metadata remain required. Reflection or arbitrary third-party code modifying private internals is outside the isolated profile.
Random equipment reserves two slots conservatively, so an unmounted randomly chosen troop can be rejected with only one free slot.
A caller explicitly forcing the mount onto the slot that automatic rider allocation would take is rejected before allocation; it is not silently rewritten to a different rider slot.
